import json,pathlib,sys
repo=pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]);own=pathlib.Path(sys.argv[2])
assert pathlib.Path.cwd()==repo
sys.path.insert(0,str(repo/'.claude/skills/ld-s10y-lesson/tools'))
import assemble
book=own/'artifacts/9-10g'
stream=assemble.load_stream(book)
start=next(i for i,b in enumerate(stream) if b['ref']=='p0308#4')
end=next(i for i,b in enumerate(stream) if b['ref']=='p0309#9')
selected=stream[start:end]
assert selected[0]['kind']==stream[end]['kind']=='h3'
assert selected[-1]['ref']=='p0309#8'
ancestor=repo/'.intentfold/tickets/STEMROBIN-188/tmp/source302-author/artifacts/9-10g/pages/0302/page.json'
heading=assemble.load_stream(book,[(ancestor,json.loads(ancestor.read_text()))])[0]
assert heading['ref']=='p0302#1' and heading['kind']=='h1'
manifest=json.loads((repo/'ssot-resources/soviet10year-textbooks/sources/manifest.json').read_text())
catalog=next(c for c in manifest['catalogs'] if c['book']=='9-10g')
status=assemble.run(book,repo/'ssot-resources/soviet10year-textbooks/toc/9-10g/zh.json',
    repo/'.claude/skills/ld-s10y-lesson/profiles/soviet-cn.json',strict=True,
    work=own/'work/9-10g',exercise_numbering=catalog.get('exerciseNumbering','book'),
    stream=[heading,*selected])
print(json.dumps({'exitCode':status,'selectedRefs':[b['ref'] for b in selected],
    'rightBoundaryExcluded':'p0309#9','source308AffectedReviewPending':True,'images':0}))
sys.exit(status)
